summary: Petal is a private tracker for prepaid service cards: nail passes, lash packages, beauty stored-value cards, gym memberships, swim cards, foot care plans, and other repeat-visit services.
features: Open count cards, stored-value cards, and period memberships
Record top-ups, bonus value, opening dates, visit dates, and real payment amounts
Log visits with specialist or coach, rating, notes, and optional photo receipts
Complete a booking and turn it into a visit record automatically
Let smart booking reminders learn from your store and service habits
Review category spending, visit counts, total paid, card usage rate, and unused cards
Keep everything local, with optional iCloud backup and restore
